usage: l0p4map [-h] [-V] {scan,gui} ...

L0p4Map — network monitoring & visualization tool

positional arguments:
  {scan,gui}
    scan         scan network and print results
    gui          launch the GUI (default when no command given)

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  -V, --version  show program's version number and exit

examples:
  sudo l0p4map                          launch GUI
  sudo l0p4map scan                     scan local subnet, table output
  sudo l0p4map scan -t 192.168.1.0/24   scan specific subnet
  sudo l0p4map scan -o json             JSON output
  sudo l0p4map scan -o csv -f out.csv   save CSV to file
